Discovery is solved ONCE here; harvesters and ETL execute this registry. Unverified domains are marked domain_verified=false and must be verified before use. The `councils` map holds 317 principal councils (SD/UA/MD/LB/SC) plus combined authorities (CA), fire and rescue authorities (FRA) and police bodies (PCC); ALWAYS filter on class before quoting a coverage denominator.

class_codes.CA: combined authority or combined county authority
class_codes.FRA: fire and rescue authority with its own accounts
class_codes.PCC: police and crime commissioner (or PFCC policing function)
